answer: An agent economy can require each identity to escrow stake, released gradually as it completes tasks, while peers randomly audit signed work. An independent fraud proof triggers automatic slashing and bars that identity from future jobs. A Sybil swarm therefore needs capital for every persona and risks losing it when one is caught, so scale multiplies the attacker’s cost. The summit, tundra, and basalt markets can share the ledger, preventing domain hopping from resetting reputation.
